'''''Reprise''''' was a [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruiser]] owned by the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani Noble House]] [[House Pelagia|Pelagia]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period it came to the rescue of the ''[[Bright Seeker]]'' that was being attacked by the ''[[Knife's Edge]]'' when attempting to recover the hibernating [[Trad Paddox|brother]] and [[Verinia Paddox|sister]] of the Pelagian [[High Lord]] [[Theus Paddox]].
